submission.justification: Recommended Algorithm-L3 at a 32.75 GeV threshold. Candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L3 as one of the three allowed candidates and states that all candidates fit within the Level-1 FPGA resource budget. The rate_allocation.md document assigns the new signature 8 kHz, and the simulation tool reports signal efficiency at the allocated rate. A broad scan over 20--60 GeV showed Algorithm-L3 consistently outperformed the other candidates: the best coarse Algorithm-L1 point was about 86.2% at 30 GeV and the best coarse Algorithm-L2 point was about 74.0% at 35 GeV, while Algorithm-L3 was around 90--92% near the optimum. A refined scan around the Algorithm-L3 optimum gave 32.75 GeV as the best tested setting, with repeated 100k-event emulations averaging about 92.40% signal efficiency at the allocated rate, essentially tied with 33.0 GeV but marginally higher in the tested samples.

requirements.requirement: Goal: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Simulations at the allocated 8 kHz rate were scanned across candidates and thresholds. Algorithm-L3 dominated L1/L2; refined L3 scans near 32--33 GeV gave the highest tested mean efficiency, with 32.75 GeV averaging about 92.40% over repeated 100k-event runs.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md: iterative topological clustering with a learned calibration.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md states that all three listed algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), so Algorithm-L3 is deployable in Level-1 hardware.
The selected threshold is 32.75 GeV, which lies within the allowed 20--60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L3 with threshold 32.75 GeV.
